newsitem.title: UK: ScotAm says final bids to be in by Friday.
newsitem.headline: ScotAm says final bids to be in by Friday.

text.p: Mutually-owned life assurer and financial services company Scottish Amicable said on Thursday it had asked Abbey National Plc, Prudential Corp and Australia's Mutual Provident (AMP) to submit final binding offers for ScotAm.
It said the bids must be submitted by 1800 GMT on Friday March 14 and that if any of the bidders wants the details made public this will be done at 0800 GMT on Monday March 17.

ScotAm said it will move as quickly as possible to announce its recommended proposal after it has evaluated the bids with the help of financial advisers SBC Warburg and anticipates a final announcement by the end of March.

In addition, ScotAm said the process will involve clarification of any outstanding technical, structural or commercial issues with the bidders; consultation with the Department of Trade and Industry; and consultation with an independent actuary who will submit a report on the recommended proposals.
The Abbey sparked a bidding war for ScotAm in January when it made a preliminary offer of up to 1.4 billion stgwhich was closely followed by a larger bid by insurance giant Prudential.
ScotAm, which had been planning to shed its mutual status and eventually float on the stock exchange, then started a formal bidding process.
